aiplayer.onboarding.title: AI Player tutorial
aiplayer.onboarding.page.0.head: Welcome! What this mod can do
aiplayer.onboarding.page.0.1: Spawn LLM-driven AI players that mine, farm, build and fight.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.0.2: They understand plain chat and also find work on their own.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.0.3: Each AI has its own name, skin, level, team and owner.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.0.4: Use them as companions on a trip, or as rivals in a firefight.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.0.5: Before any of that, they need a model service - an API.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.0.6: The next 6 pages cover it step by step; press Skip any time.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.1.head: Step 1: give the AI a brain (API)
aiplayer.onboarding.page.1.1: Press K, pick the Global tab, and fill in three fields.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.1.2: Base URL: endpoint up to the version, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1
aiplayer.onboarding.page.1.3: Do not append /chat/completions; a trailing slash is usually fine.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.1.4: API key: paste it as-is; it stays in your own config/aiplayer.json.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.1.5: Model: copy from provider docs, e.g. gpt-4o-mini or deepseek-chat.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.1.6: Any OpenAI-compatible service works: DeepSeek, Qwen, Moonshot, etc.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.2.head: Step 2: make sure it really connects
aiplayer.onboarding.page.2.1: Test connection: success shows model and latency; failure shows why.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.2.2: 401/invalid key: bad paste, or a key from another service.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.2.3: 404 or model not found: typo in the model name, or no access to it.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.2.4: 429: quota or rate limit - use another key or wait a moment.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.2.5: Timeout or connection failed: check network and proxy settings.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.2.6: Get a cheap model working first, then switch to the big one.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.3.head: Step 3: spawn your first AI
aiplayer.onboarding.page.3.1: Tabs: Profile / Features / Kit / Global / Style / Batch / List / About.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.3.2: In Profile click + New, type a unique name; skin name is optional.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.3.3: Level 0-5: higher = better aim and faster reactions; 1-2 feels human.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.3.4: Press Spawn and it appears next to you with a starter kit.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.3.5: For a whole squad, open Batch and use a template like Red{n}.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.3.6: The List tab searches, teleports, removes and auto-restores AIs.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.4.head: How to talk to them
aiplayer.onboarding.page.4.1: Type in chat: AIs within 32 blocks hear you; @name targets just one.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.4.2: The owner always gets a reply; others wait 1.5s to avoid spam.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.4.3: Come here / Follow me / Stop / Attack that run instantly, no tokens.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.4.4: Complex jobs (build a 5x5 hut) go to the model; takes a moment.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.4.6: Type /aiplayer for the full list; per-AI chat toggle is in Features.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.5.head: Gear and combat
aiplayer.onboarding.page.5.1: Give it a sword, shield or bow and it picks the right one.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.5.2: Install the TaCZ gun mod to unlock a Guns tab with its own options.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.5.3: It picks the best gun, draws, aims, and reloads when the mag runs dry.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.5.4: It falls back to bow/crossbow only with no mag and no reserve ammo.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.5.5: Kit tab sets starter gear; Features toggles mining, building, combat.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.5.6: AIs never fight each other by default; set aiDuel to true.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.6.head: When something goes wrong
aiplayer.onboarding.page.6.1: Press K to open it; if nothing happens, rebind the key in Controls.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.6.2: No replies? Run /aiplayer testllm and it prints the exact error.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.6.3: Verbose logs: set debugLog to true in config/aiplayer.json.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.6.4: All logs live in logs/aiplayer/; chat-<date>.log holds conversations.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.6.5: Safe to share: keys in logs are masked to the last 4 characters.
aiplayer.onboarding.page.6.6: Broke it? Delete config/aiplayer.json and restart for defaults.
